## Checklist

- [ ] The PR title follows `[RF-001] TYPE - Short description`.
- [ ] The branch follows `001-type-short-description`.
- [ ] The change is focused and preserves unrelated work.
- [ ] Relevant focused tests pass.
- [ ] The applicable full backend and/or frontend checks pass.
- [ ] Any applicant facts, dates, metrics, links, and contact details are source-backed.
- [ ] Automated tests mock provider boundaries; no unintended paid-provider calls were made.
- [ ] Documentation and configuration examples are updated where applicable.
- [ ] The PR is ready for review by the code owner.
